This mismatch persisted through later commits (`b81f1ac`, `3b9411d`, etc.) since none of them touched that particular line, until `e3a0924` corrected it to `Table.of(t, namespace, name, ...)`.

**(3) Supporting evidence:**
- `git log -S "of(Transaction t, Namespace namespace" -- TableRenderer.java` shows only `002e91d` as touching that exact signature text — i.e., that's when the namespace-first factory signature was introduced.

- `e3a0924`'s diff to `TableFactoryRenderer.java` changes exactly that line to `Table.of(t, namespace, name, ...)`, matching the parameter order that has existed in `TableRenderer.java` since `002e91d` (confirmed unchanged by subsequent commits `04d09dc`, `877422f`, `b81f1ac`, `ea79912`, `3b9411d`, `231c6c1`).

**Note on scope/uncertainty:** The fix commit `e3a0924` bundles several unrelated cleanups (adding `getRawTableName()`, unqualifying `of(...)` calls to `ClassName.of(...)` for style uniformity, hash-component-aware row constructors in `RowOrDynamicColumnRenderer.java`, removing wildcard imports). The other changes (style uniformity, new `getRawTableName()` API) are additions/refactors rather than fixes to a previously introduced bug, so I did not attribute them to any single introducing commit. I'm confident in `002e91d` as the bug-introducing commit for the argument-ordering defect, which appears to be the core functional bug referenced by the fix's title/description.
